notes.content:
Happy 4th Of July!

I am also doing a BF:RI key giveaway on the official discord server!
Discord : https://discord.gg/jtHJ5rdDMs

The early access launch is very soon now, alongside launch i will also update the demo build.
Didn't find the time to make a video progress update so here's a changelog of new things since then,
also the price of the game is $10 USD, with 20% discount on launch for a week.

- New Map "Dust Tunnels"
- New Map "Hamidou's Dealership"
- New Training Map (Tutorial)

- New Evidence System

- Improved Map Select UI
- Overhauled Armory Locker
- Improved Operations Base Level
- Improved Maps Ambience

See you all at launch.

notes.title: BF:RI | May Development Update
notes.content:
Hello! It has been one month since demo has launch, here is some of the progress
that has been made on BF:RI

[previewyoutube=LHh9pZ6e4Wg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]












- New scope additions using PIP method
- 3 New maps
- 3 New Weapons
- Sprinting Mechanic!
- Expanded Operations Base With Many New Rooms + Shoothouse Course

And also 67 more days until early access launch!

I am aiming to have at least 1-2 more weapons and 2 more maps at launch,
And want to also add new features such as :
- Permadeath Options (Save/Map Progression Deletion)
- HVT's To Eliminate
- Overlord Reaction/Message System
- Evidence System That Will Fill Up Evidence Room
- Tutorial Map
